English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. The English query did not identify a qualifying institute or named institute commitment. The official strategy includes national procedures and safety tests for algorithms and cites international AISI cooperation; the reviewed passages assign work across existing ministries and do not establish a national institute for advanced models. The broader query returned national AI programme and regulatory-sandbox research excerpts; these do not establish a new evaluator of advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Partial check, not a full record re-check.
